Please interpret my dream. In morning hours I dreamt that my little brothers were coming from school and were crossing the road 1518 views Q. - DREAM - I had this dream long ago. I have 4 brothers and 1 sister. I dreamnt that we were living in a lone house, in the middle of a desert. Our car was parked some way away from the house. One night (in the dream) I went to the car and started the ignition. But instead of going forward the car raised up into the air. It kept rising up and reached a most beatiful place with abundant greenry, trees and breathtaking scenery. The grass was of a very rich colour and I remember a stream flowing some way away. I have not seen a place so beautiful in my lifetime. I heard my brothers calling from down below .. they said that "Mum is calling you" .. but I was so immersed in the beauty of the place that I refused to go back down. The scene changed: I was down again. It was another night and I went to the car again. I started the ignition again. The car rose but but was stopped 5-6 feet into the air.. My brothers had tied a rope to the back of the car and now they started pulling me back. i remember insisting on going up but they brought me down. I was really sad. I kept thinking about the place. On the 7th day after I had gone to the beautiful place, I looked at the moon and found a face on it. I was about 8-10 years old when I saw this dream. Now I'm almost 19. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 43988 Country: United Kingdom Title: dream Question: Night before yesterday I saw in my dream that I am in a Masjid with no walls but a sold boundary. Instead of the floor there is sand like dust and the floor is not even. When I try to join the jamah it is not proper jamah and only one person behind the imam and even him is a young boy. When I do sajdah I taste mud. Other namazis are kind of engaged in namaz but scattered around the masjid. And that it is night time but there are not proper lights. Answer ID: 43988 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 219/183/H=1434) The dream indicates that the Muslims are becoming prey of differences and disputes in the affairs of this world and of hereafter which may harm them. May Almighty Allah have mercy upon Muslims and reform them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
